summary: Observation sheets for investigation OT-10-S0019, the exploratory NM-31 rat dose-range finding for Nimbravelle Medicines Inc. The DRF table is a group summary supporting longer-study dose selection. Individual animal cards, recovery findings and dose-lot preparation/conversion records are unavailable in this workbook; their absence limits individual-animal and delivered-dose traceability.
